_note: Daily content library — the marketplace's daily collections. lib/daily-content.js picks one per day (deterministic, day-of-year) and renders its three plates on Midjourney. Each plate carries the caption and alt text the marketplace page shows, so the copy is written once here and never drifts from the art. The prompt is subject-first (the acceptance-matcher rule from the MJ sheet work): the subject leads, then camera, light and texture, then 'no text'. The aspect ratio is appended by the pipeline, not stored here.
